title: The Wallet System for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 2.8.2 does not restrict its KYC document submission handler…
description: The Wallet System for WooCommerce WordPress plugin versions before 2.8.2 contains a vulnerability in its KYC document submission handler. It fails to restrict document submissions to the authenticated user's own account, allowing users with minimal privileges to overwrite KYC documents and verification status of any other user, including administrators.
